newsitem.title: USA: Conrail testimony ends, ruling seen soon.
newsitem.headline: Conrail testimony ends, ruling seen soon.

text.p: Arguments ended early Thursday afternoon in a U.S. district court hearing into CSX Corp's proposed acquisition of Conrail Inc.
Attorneys in the case said a ruling by Judge Donald Van Artsdalen was expected when court reconvened at 1400 EST/1900 GMT.
Norfolk Southern Corp, a rival bidder for Conrail, is challenging terms of the proposed transaction that prohibit Conrail and CSX from entering merger talks with another party until 1999.
Norfolk Southern also contends that the voting power of CSX's stake in Conrail already has crossed a key 20 percent threshold that would require CSX to pay all cash for Conrail.
CSX has proposed a cash and stock transaction.

Van Artsdalen asked a Norfolk Southern attorney several questions about the 20 percent threshold, including how the law would be applied if directors of a target company already owned more than 20 pct of the shares.
